_note: Next Top Comic (DESIGN.md): stand-up mini-game using the dialogue system in Monkey Island insult-sword-fighting structure (Sarah Silverman). Just horrible unfunny setup / punchline pairings, but the women in the audience think it's hilarious. 'sources' are the comics whose 'jokes' (data/quotes/<id>.json, setup and punchline as separate lines) are mixed into one shared pool: Sarah Silverman and the player draw from the same lines, fully randomized, so a pairing that happens to fit doesn't matter. 'interjections' are the author's lines, added to the punchline pool so they turn up every so often.
